info.description: Complete REST API documentation for FluentCRM — a self-hosted email marketing and CRM plugin for WordPress.

post.summary: POST Get Or Generate Contact Summary
post.description:
Read, generate, or regenerate the AI summary shown on a contact profile.

The two flags decide which of three behaviours you get:

| `generate` | `regenerate` | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| `no` | `no` | Return the cached summary if one exists for the current site locale, otherwise return an empty `summary` and `cached: false`. Makes no provider call. |
| `yes` | `no` | Return the cache when valid, otherwise generate and cache a new summary. |
| any | `yes` | Ignore the cache and generate a fresh summary. |

Summaries are cached in subscriber meta under `_ai_contact_summary` and are keyed to the **site** language (Settings → General → Site Language), not the admin user's profile language. A cached summary generated under a different locale is treated as a miss. Summaries cached before locale tracking existed are reused only while the site locale is English.

Generation blocks for up to 45 seconds.

<!-- fc:access -->

**Required capability:** `fcrm_read_contacts`

_Enforced by `AiPolicy::contactSummary()`._

<!-- /fc:access -->

subscriber_id.description: Contact to summarise. Required and must be non-zero.

generate.description: Send `yes` to generate when the cache misses.

regenerate.description: Send `yes` to bypass the cache and force a fresh summary.

200.description: The cached or freshly generated summary.

summary.description: Summary payload. An empty object when nothing is cached and generation was not requested.

locale.description: Site locale the summary was written for, e.g. `en_US`.

cached.description: True when the response came from subscriber meta rather than a fresh provider call.

summary.content: Long-standing customer, highly engaged with product release emails...

401.description: Not authenticated — missing or invalid credentials.

403.description: Authenticated but the user lacks the capability this route requires.

422.description: `subscriber_id` missing or zero, AI disabled, or the provider returned an error.

404.description: No contact exists with that id.
